invariants.name: A write or a push in a copy never changes the template or its origin
A write or a push in a copy never changes another copy
Each ready copy has a clean index
A template at its final path is a complete build

carrier.contract: Each arrow maps a fixture folder to a fixture folder. A ready copy is a new repo with the template commits, its own origin and a clean index, and no write in it reaches the template or another copy.

category.equality: Two templates are equal when their folders hold the same refs, objects and git config. Two copies are equal when their refs, their remote URLs and the state of their index are equal.

laws.reason: copyRepo calls copyTemplate, rewriteConfig and refreshIndex as plain calls, and the record declares no composite arrow. This change adds no composition operator, map, functor or monad.

abstraction.hides: The git object layout, the fast-import stream, the config path rewrite and the index refresh of each copied repo.
callersKnow: A copy is a new folder with the template commits, and each copied repo has its own origin.
A write or a push in a copy never reaches the template or another copy.
A new copy passes git diff-index --quiet HEAD.
commitTree writes each branch at fixed past dates, so two copies of one template get the same commit ids.
A build that throws leaves no folder, and removeTemplate removes the folder of a template.
abstraction.deletionTest: Without the helper, each of the 5 files keeps its own chain of init, add, commit and push calls for each test.

alternatives.name: git clone --shared or --reference
alternatives.rejectedBecause: The copies then share objects with the template.

alternatives.name: An add and a commit for each branch
alternatives.rejectedBecause: A repo then costs 53 to 71 ms, from 17 to 24 ms with one fast-import stream.

omitted: The git objects, the files and the index are abstracted to one commit count for each repo and one clean flag for each copy.
removeTemplate and the template cache of each file are not in the model. The fx-own-dir control and the pr-head order runs examine them.
The scan runner of check:companion and the timeout budget are not in the model. The fx-real-scan control and the timed runs examine them.

bounds: One template, two copies and at most 2 commits in each copy.
A build of 2 steps that can stop before its end and start again.
Each order of the copy, rewrite, refresh, commit and push steps of each copy.

negative.defect: A copy that keeps the origin URL of the template pushes into the origin of the template, as a copy with no config rewrite does.

limits: The finite model takes git, the file copy and the index refresh as true observations. The fx-isolate, fx-index, fx-tree and fx-atomic controls examine them.
The model does not check the git spawn counts, the timeout budget or the suite times. The timed runs in the PR Verification give them.
The model does not check the words of the docs, the ADR and the plan. Review and the STE gates examine them.
Exact-head CI, review and every ordinary gate stay required.
